latestVersion.changelog:
chrome-extension-launch-coach 1.0.0

- Initial release of an end-to-end coaching tool for solo developers and small teams launching browser extensions as real, monetized products.
- Covers the entire product journey: idea validation, MV3 build guidance, store listing and review prep, permissions discipline, monetization strategies, anti-cloning, and scaling options.
- Diagnostic sweep includes targeted questions on product, build state, audience, monetization, compliance, and cloneability to diagnose project viability.
- Triggered by common extension-building topics, including Manifest V3, extension monetization, store listing, permissions, update management, and portfolio scaling.
- Offers detailed, actionable advice for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari extension projects aiming for commercial or SaaS-adjacent success.
